main_text.l: Rogerius II. Siciliae ac Italiae Rex 33, 34

page.notes: Printed in the scan: the entry "Romanum Imperium 25." and "26,27" on the next line are printed as two lines. Possible misreadings: "Petr. Ferd. del Qvier" (the word "del" is run into "Qvier" in print), "Hida'kan", "Ruffotum"/"Rufforum", "Kasjo" and "Arbaca" are read from the scan and may be imprecise. The last entry "Saraceni partem Roma-" continues as "ni" at the foot of the column, with the printed hyphen kept. The word "Momyll" is followed by superscript o marks as printed.
